title: Payment service rollback
content: Rollback procedure: 1) confirm the error-rate or p95 latency threshold breach; 2) freeze further deployment; 3) identify the previous known-good image; 4) shift traffic away from the canary; 5) redeploy the previous image; 6) verify health, payment success rate and database pool utilization; 7) record the rollback in the incident timeline. Never roll back database schema changes without the database migration plan.
